        <h1 class='oc-page-title '>Agendas and minutes</h1>
        
        <p>Hepburn Shire's Councillors are responsible for making important decisions about the Shire on behalf of the community.</p>
<p>The current agenda is available online or can be viewed in person at our Council offices, generally from 12 noon on the Thursday prior to the meeting.</p>
<p>Decisions are made at Council Meetings which are open to the public. </p>
